methodology.question: Can additional already-admitted daily-open information distinguish price-path variation from close-to-close cancellation, within the original option/dollar allocation architecture? This is one information-sampling hypothesis, not a window/share/band search or a demonstrated return predictor.
methodology.proxy: For each of the same21completed sessions, compute o=log(adjusted_open/current_previous_adjusted_close) and d=log(adjusted_close/adjusted_open). The annualized proxy is252*mean(o^2+d^2), not504times a daily sum, not a centered sample variance and not a weighted average over unequal clock durations.
methodology.identity: The original daily log return is o+d. Its squared variation equals this proxy plus252*mean(2*o*d). The two-segment proxy can be higher or lower; it is not guaranteed more conservative. If either segment is zero every day it recovers the existing close-only proxy. Opposite movements can expose variation despite zero close-to-close change.
methodology.allocation: Use the same unit-coefficient odds law as the eleventh study: equity fraction GVZ*VIX/(GVZ*VIX+two_segment_proxy) in decimal volatility units, clipped to original30%-70%bounds. Preserve original half-SOXX/equal-four-style relative equity composition, source BIL and non-BIL dollar-guard scale, all131monthly decisions and unchanged monthly observed0.025band execution.
methodology.source: Read the unchanged admitted twelve-fund panel and saved original guarded targets. Both SPY price fields are vendor-adjusted model prices: adjusted open=raw open*adjusted close/raw close. Cross-day adjustment changes, distributions and weekend gaps follow that existing convention. This is not an authenticated auction-price or actual overnight-only trading return series. All values are known only after the completed signal close, for original1/2session-later execution.
methodology.scope: Two coarse daily intervals are not high-frequency realized variance, true quadratic variation, true variance risk premium, intraday-paper replication, a Yang-Zhang/Rogers-Satchell range estimator or a new economic factor. No high/low data, new feed, interpolation, source-gap fill or inferred option return is used.
methodology.execution: One freshUSD10000 account per original10y/5y/base-stress path, all12assets1x/fractional/cash-funded, originalRF/initialpeak/USD1tickets/5-20bp/1-2session delay. No broker action, old account replay, early fill or pending-request cancellation.

A fixed additional information partition is not an independent holdout; no coefficient/segment/window/share/band/asset grid or post-result estimator rescue.
